name: Letterboxd Lists
author: Thunderhat
description: Turn public Letterboxd lists into Plex collections of the films you own, with a report of the ones you are missing.

settingsSchema.label: Letterboxd list URLs
settingsSchema.help: One public list per line, for example https://letterboxd.com/username/list/list-name/

settingsSchema.label: Movie libraries
settingsSchema.help: No libraries are selected by default. Each library with at least one film from a list gets its own collection named after the list.

settingsSchema.label: Add missing films to my Plex watchlist
settingsSchema.help: Films on a list that are in none of your libraries are added to your Plex watchlist once. Removing one from the watchlist keeps it off.

settingsSchema.label: Email when missing films change
settingsSchema.help: Sends a summary when the set of missing films on any list changes. Uses the mail server on the Mail page.

settingsSchema.label: Send emails to
settingsSchema.help: Leave blank to use the default recipient on the Mail page.
